scope: M1 binary-return development diagnostic; no actor, shared-adapter or joint SFT update
loss: unchanged unbounded scalar MSE; no sigmoid or BCE factor
sampling: unchanged uniform task / episode / nonterminal decision; matched seed-specific sample sequence
checkpoint_rule: fixed final step 500; no validation checkpoint selection
calibration_rule: Report raw MSE and out-of-range mass; clip to [0,1] only for separately named Brier/calibration reports, never for training or advantage
primary_diagnostics: Within-target MSE versus training global/task/time baselines; binary calibration; per-task initial success AUROC against matched RECAP heads
uncertainty: Paired complete development scenes, conditional on fitted heads; not independent collection replications
auc_bootstrap: 2000 paired resamples within task/outcome, retaining observed class counts; mean per-seed AUROC, not an ensemble
mse_bootstrap: 2000 paired episode resamples within task; conditional on fitted heads
limits: Do not compare raw MAE across reward units, treat full failure trajectories as negative advantages, or infer grounding/causal time shortcuts from these two visually distinct tasks
